settings.label: Logo image
settings.info: Optional. If left blank, the shop name is shown as a wordmark, matching the VELORA demo.

settings.label: Favicon image
settings.info: Will be scaled down to 32 x 32px

settings.content: These default to the fixed VELORA brand tokens (Black / Ivory / Warm Beige / Charcoal / Burgundy) used throughout the master design. Adjust only if you intend to depart from the brand guidelines.

settings.label: Accent — deep burgundy (links, sale badges, CTAs on hover)
Free shipping threshold
settings.info: Amount (in your shop's currency, in the smallest currency unit shown by money_format) at which the free-shipping progress bar in the cart drawer/cart page reaches 100%. The VELORA demo uses ₹4,000 — Shopify's own shop currency setting (Settings > General) governs how amounts actually display at checkout; this setting only drives the visual progress bar.

settings.label: Use cart drawer
settings.info: When enabled, adding a product opens the slide-in cart drawer, matching the demo. The dedicated cart page (/cart) is always available.

settings.label: Default meta description
settings.default: Velora is a premium fashion house crafting tailored dresses, outerwear, knitwear and accessories from responsibly sourced natural fibres. Shop the New Season collection.
settings.info: Used as a fallback on any page that has no page-specific description (product/collection descriptions are preferred automatically when present).

settings.label: Default social sharing image
settings.info: Used for Open Graph / Twitter previews when a page has no more specific image (e.g. no product/collection image).

settings.content: Shopify has no native wishlist object. Wishlist state is stored client-side in the shopper's browser via localStorage, keyed by product handle (see assets/theme.js, VeloraWishlist). It is per-browser, not synced to the customer account.
